summary: CVE-2026-93536 affecting package xorg-x11-server-Xwayland for versions less than 24.1.14-1
details: A use after free caused by missing lifecycle management of gesture sprites in GestureBuildSprite() in X.Org X Server before 21.1.25 and XWayland before 24.1.14 could be used by authenticated X clients to crash the X server or potentially execute code.
